{{Quote|Narj climb tall Highmount Slopes over Highmount Ridge, looking for vantage. Accidentally find group living atop mountain. Narj lost arm to tooth and claw. Will take time to regrow.|[[Brek]]'s notes|<ref name="Stalking the Score" />}}
'''Narj''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who joined the [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]], a former [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] that was led by [[Qyzen Fess]] during the era in which the [[Eternal Empire]] controlled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In his efforts to teach his students about the Trandoshan [[Deity/Legends|goddess]] [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]] and the glory of the hunt, Qyzen brought Narj and other Warstalkers to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to hunt beasts worthy of rewarding [[Jagannath point/Legends|jagannath points]]. Narj [[Scout/Legends|scouted]] the [[Highmount Ridge]] and lost an arm to the beasts living atop the [[Highmount Slopes]], though the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan's]] [[Limb/Legends|limb]] would eventually grow back.<ref name="Stalking the Score" />
